citations.claim: energy rising before violation despite no controller work

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.02138 to 0.001 (single field); keeps all other parameters and 4 steps. Smaller dt eliminates integration error so energy stays ~1656.8 and no violation occurs.

explanation: No walls, no controller (work=0). With large dt=0.02138 and high speed (~57 m/s), semi-implicit Euler substepped ~41-43 times per step still integrates free-fall inaccurately, causing monotonic energy growth about +174 J over 4 steps, exceeding 10%+5J tolerance. Reducing dt to 0.001 removes the error, proving numerical integration error, not external work.
vision_note: A single blue body moves steadily down and to the right across steps 1-4 in an empty arena with no walls, waypoints, or collisions visible. No tunneling, wall penetration, or abrupt jump is seen; the motion looks like normal fast free-fall between frames.
